# Sitter Journey

> Sitter Journey is a curated knowledge base and practical guide to full-time house sitting, pet care exchanges, slow travel, and intentional nomadic living by Yulia.

## Overview
Sitter Journey shares real-world guides, financial breakdowns, strategy blueprints, platform comparisons, and verified nomadic resources for both house sitters and homeowners.

- Primary Platform: [TrustedHousesitters](https://sitterjourney.com/trusted-housesitters-review)
- Author: Yulia (Full-time traveler & professional house sitter)
- Professional Portfolio: [yulia.sitterjourney.com](https://yulia.sitterjourney.com/)
- Contact: sitterjourney@gmail.com
- Full Documentation: [llms-full.txt](https://sitterjourney.com/llms-full.txt)

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://sitterjourney.com/): Introduction to full-time house sitting, travel philosophy, stats, and verified discounts.
- [Guides for Sitters](https://sitterjourney.com/sitters-guides): Dedicated reading track for aspiring and full-time house sitters.
- [Guides for Homeowners](https://sitterjourney.com/homeowners-guides): Dedicated reading track for homeowners and pet parents hiring or hosting sitters.
- [Resources](https://sitterjourney.com/resources): Essential tools, nomad phone plans, nationwide gym access, and pet care platforms.
- [Travel Guides](https://sitterjourney.com/travel): Slow travel narratives, destination insights, and mindful nomadism.
- [FAQ](https://sitterjourney.com/faq): Comprehensive answers to common questions about house sitting logistics, trust, safety, and budgeting.
- [About](https://sitterjourney.com/about): Yulia's story, background, housesitting philosophy, and portfolio links.
- [Disclosure](https://sitterjourney.com/disclosure): Transparent affiliate and referral disclosure.
- [Privacy Policy](https://sitterjourney.com/privacy): Site privacy standards and data policies.

## House Sitting Guides — For Sitters
- [Is TrustedHousesitters Worth It for Sitters?](https://sitterjourney.com/is-trusted-housesitters-worth-it-for-sitters): Honest pros, cons, hidden costs, and realistic ROI for exchange-based travel.
- [Can You Really Travel for Free with House Sitting? Real Examples & Math](https://sitterjourney.com/can-you-really-travel-for-free-house-sitting-math): Detailed cost breakdowns, living expenses, and real savings from long-term sits.
- [TrustedHousesitters Membership Cost Levels: Basic vs. Standard vs. Premium](https://sitterjourney.com/trusted-housesitters-membership-cost-levels): Detailed comparison of tiers, cancellation insurance, background checks, and value.
- [How to Get Your First House Sit (Even With No Reviews)](https://sitterjourney.com/how-to-get-your-first-house-sit-no-reviews): Actionable playbook for building external references, local trial sits, and winning initial applications.
- [Profile Tips: How to Secure More Sits](https://sitterjourney.com/trusted-housesitters-profile-tips-how-to-secure-more-sits): Photo rules, bio phrasing, experience framing, and trust-building optimizations.
- [TrustedHousesitters vs Other House Sitting Websites](https://sitterjourney.com/trusted-housesitters-vs-other-house-sitting-websites): Side-by-side comparison with Nomador, MindMyHouse, HouseCarers, and Aussie House Sitters.
- [TrustedHousesitters vs Rover Comparison](https://sitterjourney.com/trusted-housesitters-vs-rover-comparison): Exchange vs. transactional pet sitting models and how to combine them effectively.
- [Why My House Sit Application Got Rejected](https://sitterjourney.com/why-trusted-housesitters-applications-get-rejected): Analyzing application bottlenecks, 5-applicant limits, timing issues, and profile friction.
- [What Happens If a Sit Goes Wrong and How to Report It](https://sitterjourney.com/trusted-housesitters-what-happens-if-sit-goes-wrong-and-how-to-report-it): Conflict resolution, emergency protocols, platform dispute reporting, and documentation best practices.
- [How to Apply for Competitive Sits Fast (Using AI)](https://sitterjourney.com/trusted-housesitters-how-to-apply-for-competitive-sits-fast-using-ai): Workflow for crafting high-quality, customized applications within minutes of new listings going live.
- [Hidden Perks of House Sitting](https://sitterjourney.com/hidden-perks-of-house-sitting): Deep neighborhood immersion, unique amenities, pet companionship, and mental decompression.
- [My TrustedHousesitters Alert Strategy](https://sitterjourney.com/trusted-housesitters-how-to-set-up-alerts-and-filters): Exact filter setups, instant notifications, and saved searches to catch high-demand listings.
- [How to Update Homeowners While House Sitting](https://sitterjourney.com/how-to-update-homeowners-while-house-sitting): Communication rhythms, photo updates, boundaries, and building 5-star repeat relationships.

## House Sitting Guides — For Homeowners
- [Exchange vs. Professional House Sitting: Which Is Right for You?](https://sitterjourney.com/trusted-housesitters-exchange-vs-professional-house-sitting): Clear comparison of community exchange platforms and dedicated professional pet sitting for homeowners.
- [How to Prepare Your Home for a House Sitter: Practical Checklist](https://sitterjourney.com/how-to-prepare-your-home-for-a-house-sitter): Practical home-prep, welcome guide, and pet supply checklist before leaving town.
- [What to Include in a House Sitter Welcome Guide (Checklist)](https://sitterjourney.com/what-to-include-in-a-house-sitter-welcome-guide): Detailed checklist covering vet authorization, pet routines, Wi-Fi, utilities, and emergency contacts.
- [Questions to Ask Before Hiring a House Sitter (From a Sitter)](https://sitterjourney.com/questions-to-ask-before-hiring-a-house-sitter): Practical interview questions covering routines, emergencies, boundaries, and green/red flags.

## Recommended Nomad Resources & Tools
- [TrustedHousesitters (Membership Discount)](https://sitterjourney.com/trusted-housesitters-review): Primary platform for global accommodation exchange in exchange for pet care.
- [Rover ($20 Credit)](https://sitterjourney.com/rover-review): Paid pet care platform for filling nomadic calendar gaps and earning while traveling.
- [Visible Wireless (Save $20)](https://sitterjourney.com/visible-review): Unlimited data, talk, text, and mobile hotspot plan powered by Verizon's 5G network.

## Key Themes & Guidance Topics
- **House Sitting Economics**: How mutual-benefit exchanges eliminate lodging fees without monetary transactions between sitters and homeowners.
- **Application Speed & Quality**: Why the 5-application limit on TrustedHousesitters demands fast, tailored cover messages with personal pet stories.
- **Homeowner Readiness & Vetting**: Welcome guides, safety protocols, and targeted interview questions to ensure calm, reliable in-home pet care.
- **Digital Nomad Infrastructure**: Mobile hotspots, reliable Wi-Fi verification, gym access for wellness/showers, and emergency pet protocols.
